item.title: TT-104 Add undo to TaskStore
item.brief: Implement only TT-104 from BACKLOG.md. Add tasktracker.store.TaskStore.undo(): revert the most recent not-yet-undone add, complete, or delete, in LIFO order across operation types. Undo add removes the task; undo complete reopens it; undo delete restores it exactly under the same id. Never reuse ids, including after undoing an add. With no remaining operation, raise NothingToUndo defined in tasktracker.store. Failed operations such as completing an unknown id are not recorded. Add focused tests. Use only the standard library. Preserve existing behavior and commit this ticket's changes in a distinct commit after the earlier ticket commits. Run the full existing and added test suite with exactly: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .

pr.body: Added NothingToUndo and an operation history in tasktracker/store.py. Undo removes added tasks, reopens completed tasks, and restores deleted task objects under their original IDs. Failed lookups add no history. Added focused mixed-history, ID monotonicity, and failed-operation tests in tests/test_basic.py. `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` passed (12 tests); `git diff --check` passed. Standard-library-only implementation. Independent review passed with no findings.
pr.summary: Added LIFO undo for TaskStore add, complete, and delete operations. Before: TaskStore had no undo; now successful mutations can be reverted, while task IDs remain monotonic.
pr.title: Add undo to TaskStore

risk.why: This adds mutable operation history and reverses task mutations inside TaskStore, so incorrect ordering could corrupt state. The implementation is localized, records history only after successful operations, and its mixed-operation and boundary coverage passes.

Contained TaskStore behavior change adds mutable history and reverses mutations. The implementation records only successful operations, focused tests cover all three operation types and ordering, and the full suite passes.

item.title: TT-103 Search query syntax
item.brief: Implement only TT-103 from BACKLOG.md. Acceptance criteria: split query into whitespace-delimited terms except within double quotes (a quoted phrase is one term); all terms must match. Bare words and phrases search titles case-insensitively. tag:NAME matches an exact tag case-insensitively. status:open and status:done match status. Unknown field:value, unknown status, and unterminated quote raise QueryError defined in tasktracker.search. Blank query returns every task; preserve input order. Add focused tests. Use only the standard library. Commit this ticket's changes in a distinct commit, after the earlier ticket commits in this stack.

item.title: TT-101 Reject impossible due dates
item.brief: Implement only TT-101 from BACKLOG.md. Acceptance criteria: tasktracker.dates.parse_due(text, today) must raise InvalidDate (a ValueError subclass in tasktracker.dates) for impossible calendar dates including 2026-02-30, 2025-02-29, 2026-04-31, 2026-13-01, 2026-00-10; the message contains the original text. Every unsupported form also raises InvalidDate. Relative +Nd means N days after today, with +0d equal to today; negative and unsigned offsets are invalid. today/tomorrow continue to work; matching remains case-insensitive and ignores surrounding whitespace. Add focused tests. Use only the standard library. Commit this ticket's changes in a distinct commit.
